gemini.rationale: The slice documents the divestiture of the Antioxidant and Consumer Products businesses, which involved retaining shared production assets bridged by supply agreements and eliminating stranded costs through organizational restructuring. However, there is no documented evidence of product/process incoherence or process/organization fracture stemming from an acquisition integration over the observed window.

grok.performance_metric: 2013 divestitures (Antioxidants, Consumer Products); $(180)M loss on sale
grok.rationale: The slice's 'product/process interface' passage only records that the Antioxidant divestiture moved dedicated plants while shared assets were retained under supply agreements—a sale-execution detail, not documented multi-year failure to align an acquired product with operating processes—so p4_pathway is 0.
